snippet.title: BOINGBOUND — A Bigger Climb | Demo 2.0 Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the free demo & wishlist BOINGBOUND on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5425400/BOINGBOUND/

Hold Space. Aim. Let go. One bad jump can send you all the way back down.

Take a fresh look at BOINGBOUND, our challenging 3D climbing platformer starring animals on springs. Leap from the forest floor into the sky, meet fellow climbers and chase the legend of the Golden Spring.

Demo 2.0 is out now, with a bigger climb and quality-of-life improvements:
• Nine areas to explore, reaching roughly 520 metres above the forest floor.
• A refreshed painted look, fuller foliage and waterfalls.
• Animal NPC climbers with conversations and tips along the way.
• Richer landing sounds and layered music.
• Refreshed menus, a clearer charge bar and a quieter HUD.
• Optional Fall Steering to gently influence your descent after a long fall.

This trailer showcases the full game's climb, including areas beyond the free demo. BOINGBOUND is single-player; the other climbers are NPCs.

Read the Demo 2.0 update:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/5425400/view/713416661425718999

How high can you get? Tell us which jump nearly ended your run.

Developed by Barque 42.
Music: “Homebound” — Ovani Sound, Hyper Action Music Pack Vol. 2.
In-engine gameplay with cinematic camera staging and edited playback speed.

#BOINGBOUND #IndieGame #3DPlatformer
